# Stack & Borrow

Bitcoin-backed loan calculator and lender comparison. Compare borrowing against selling bitcoin with tax-aware scenarios, transparent lender terms, and independent cost rankings. This educational tool is not an offer or solicitation to borrow; lender terms and eligibility can change, so users must confirm current details directly with the lender. Rankings use published terms and do not determine personal suitability.

## Core pages
- [Overview](https://stackandborrow.com/): Product summary and calculator preview.
- [Bitcoin loan calculator](https://stackandborrow.com/calculator): Compare borrowing and selling across price scenarios.
- [Lender comparison](https://stackandborrow.com/lenders): Compare lender terms and costs.
- [Methodology and glossary](https://stackandborrow.com/about): How rankings, assumptions, and key terms work.
- [Swedish tax guide](https://stackandborrow.com/skatt-bitcoin-lan): Swedish tax considerations for loans secured by bitcoin.

## Lender profiles and comparisons
- [Lender directory](https://stackandborrow.com/lenders): Profiles for supported lenders.
- [Bitcoin loan comparison pages](https://stackandborrow.com/compare/arch-vs-aven): Pairwise lender comparisons.

## Machine-readable data
- [Lender data](https://stackandborrow.com/lenders.json): Current lender information used by the site.
- [Agent resource discovery manifest](https://stackandborrow.com/.well-known/ard.json): Machine-readable site resource map.
